freeze_rule: Commit before reference output generation, candidate implementation or numerical tests; do not retune after comparison.
scope: Select an explicit research source convention; qualify only the supplied-vector solar Shapiro component and census a frozen historical sample domain. No end-to-end or physical arrival-time qualification.

convention.solar_normalization: distance_to_sun_in_au; zero at R_sun=1 au and mu=0; do not fit away offsets
convention.solar_sign: add negative PINT propagation delay to source coordinate
convention.vector_epoch: simultaneous geometric observer and Sun positions, no apparent-position or observe() light-time iteration
convention.clock: TT(TAI) to TDB using location-aware ERFA dtdb via Astropy; topocentric contribution included exactly once; no separate r_site.v_earth/c^2 addition
convention.target: fixed ICRS unit direction at infinity; no proper motion, parallax or radial velocity
convention.compatibility_claim: Matching declarations permit this research comparison only; neither a generic BJD_TDB label nor self-declared metadata authenticates a catalogue source.

constants.gm_status: fixed model constant matching PINT 1.1.7, not an exact physical measurement or uncertainty bound

component_domain.meaning: geometric solar elongation at least acos(0.8); research exclusion, not a solar-observing safety criterion
component_domain.boundary_policy: strict inclusive numeric comparisons; no epsilon expansion or clamping

historical_census.generation: Skyfield 1.55/DE421 simultaneous Sun minus WGS84 observer vectors; frozen Mission 38 EOP/leaps and four dates, four sites, six directions, three hours
historical_census.coverage: finite samples only; no continuous-time, all-sky, horizon, weather or future-date qualification
historical_census.outside_policy: retain every excluded row, reasons and null reference correction; never silently omit it

reference.execution: invoke installed PINT component, not a local copy or full timing model; negate returned delay for comparison
reference.independence: PINT NumPy vector implementation versus local stdlib Decimal scalar implementation. Shared formula/constants and supplied Skyfield vectors are explicit; no independent geometry, clock or physical-reference uncertainty claim.

numeric_policy.rationale: Predeclared 1 ps component arithmetic agreement threshold, not an absolute physical error or inferred reference uncertainty. No refitting, mean subtraction or data-dependent tolerance.
numeric_policy.input_size: finite decimal strings, at most 80 characters and magnitude at most 1e40
numeric_policy.vector_note: Integrity check for serialized float vectors/scalars and unit direction; not a physical angular bound.

mutation_policy.requirement: At least one detection per fault across eligible rows, while reporting all undetected cases and total denominators; exact-zero and R=1 examples may be insensitive.

blockers: no matched independent full clock reference
continuous domain and inverse certificates absent

sources.use: term taxonomy and angular-only equation 5; do not equate this normalization with the selected radial convention
component sign, vector direction and au normalization; installed 1.1.7 source hashes authoritative
installed get_barycentric_toas subtracts delays; no full pipeline claimed
retained Mission 39 location-aware clock audit; no new clock-accuracy claim
